scope: Actual SDK printf/va-list/flush/private byte writer, compiled strlen; exact buffered/callback bytes, flags/width/precision, signed extremes, strings and CR insertion
limitations: Valid bounded formats, args and positive buffer sizes; null string arguments, unterminated formats and concurrent callbacks are not admitted.
Double formatting is disabled; unsupported specifier behavior is tested but no floating output is claimed.
Callbacks are byte sinks, not physical transport; original compiler/runtime identity, full image linking and byte equality remain unresolved.
